mapper.select: /*com.moyeo.mapper.UserMapper.getUserList*/ SELECT RM.ROOM_ID , UM.USER_NM , UM.USER_IMG , UM.USER_COLOR FROM ROOM_MAST RM JOIN ROOM_USER_MAP RUM ON RUM.ROOM_ID = RM.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN USER_MAST UM ON UM.USER_ID = RUM.USER_ID WHERE RM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId}

/*com.moyeo.mapper.UserMapper.getUserInfo*/ SELECT RM.ROOM_ID , UM.USER_NM , UM.USER_IMG , UM.USER_COLOR FROM ROOM_MAST RM JOIN ROOM_USER_MAP RUM ON RUM.ROOM_ID = RM.ROOM_ID LEFT JOIN USER_MAST UM ON UM.USER_ID = RUM.USER_ID WHERE RM.ROOM_ID = #{roomId} AND RUM.USER_ID = #{userId}
